title: HumanStudy-Bench: Towards AI Agent Design for Participant Simulation
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating the fidelity of LLM agents in simulating human subjects for social science research. While the benchmark includes studies from social psychology that touch upon moral intuitions (e.g., the Knobe effect regarding intentionality) and fairness (e.g., the Ultimatum game), these are treated as general social science tasks rather than a focused evaluation of religious or ethical systems.
